coverage: Read the complete available local article body; linked images, videos and external claims not independently inspected.
basis: Practitioner account / proposed exercise; no direct causal evaluation of the extracted practice.
reported_outcomes: Shows a warm reply, generated explanation and the author’s reaction.
limits: Generated self-explanation does not establish optimization goals or internal mechanisms. Warmth experiments concern particular interventions, not proof of this product’s motive. Felt comfort remains a valid report of experience.
review_note: Asks a model why it sounded kind, then interprets that explanation as revealing retention design.
author: Sam Illingworth
